nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires on any failure of a workflow that names this workflow as its errorWorkflow.

nodes.name: Normalize Error
nodes.notes: v3.4: field mappings corrected to the actual n8n Error Trigger schema {execution:{id,url,error,lastNodeExecuted}, workflow:{id,name}}.

nodes.name: Claim Alert Slot
nodes.notes: ATOMIC CLAIM: single INSERT; PK on alert_key. (unchanged from v3.1)

nodes.name: Classify Claim Error
nodes.notes: Conflict => duplicate-stop. Any other error => FAIL OPEN. (unchanged)

nodes.name: Duplicate?
nodes.notes: TRUE => already alerted this hour => stop. FALSE => send. (unchanged)

nodes.name: Duplicate — Stop
nodes.notes: Terminal: duplicate suppressed for this hour-bucket. (unchanged)

parameters.subject: =🚨 LiTT P0 FAILURE [{{ $('Normalize Error').first().json.workflow_id }}]

nodes.name: Send Alert Email
nodes.notes: DISABLED FOR STAGING — would send owner alert email

nodes.name: Email Delivered?
nodes.notes: TRUE => backfill claim then record. FALSE => Fail Loudly. (unchanged)

nodes.name: Backfill Claim
nodes.notes: NEW v3.2: best-effort claim insert before recording. 23505 => row exists => fine. Shared by Discord + Email paths. Both outputs go to Resolve Delivery Record.

nodes.name: Resolve Delivery Record
nodes.notes: v3.4: channel attribution fixed — prefers the Confirm node whose delivery actually confirmed.

nodes.name: Delivery Recordable?
nodes.notes: NEW v3.2: TRUE => Mark Delivered. FALSE => Delivered — Unrecorded.

nodes.name: Delivered — Recorded
nodes.notes: v3.3: success terminal (was "Mark Delivered"). Error output -> Capture Record Error -> Delivered — Unrecorded. A delivered alert is never reported as failed.

nodes.name: Delivered — Unrecorded
nodes.notes: NEW v3.2 terminal: the alert WAS delivered, but Supabase was unavailable so the outcome could not be recorded. Explicit terminal state — NOT an execution failure.

nodes.name: Capture Record Error
nodes.notes: v3.3: preserves DB error details + delivery context when the delivery record insert fails after a confirmed delivery.

nodes.name: Record Failed Delivery
nodes.notes: Records a 'failed' delivery row when Gmail rejects the alert, before the claim is released for a future retry.
